hooks.command: file_path=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(d).tool_input.file_path||'')}catch(e){}})"); if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(ts|html|scss)$ ]]; then cd src/frontend && npx prettier --write "$file_path" 2>/dev/null && npx eslint --fix "$file_path"; fi; true
